newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Libyan donates money to family of Jordanian soldier.
newsitem.headline: Libyan donates money to family of Jordanian soldier.

text.p: A Libyan will grant 20,000 Libyan dinars ($72,600) to the family of the Jordanian soldier who killed seven Israeli schoolgirls this month, the official Libyan News Agency JANA reported on Thursday.
JANA, monitored in Tunis, said the donation was made by a Libyan citizen it named as Maree Azwai.

Jordanian Sergeant Ahmed al-Daqamsa emptied the clip of his rifle earlier this month at the girls on a school trip to Baqoura, a Jordanian border territory leased to Israel under the 1994 peace treaty.
He was arrested and the Jordanian authorities had said that there was no evidence the murder was politically-motivated.
